function.description: Returns the count of network device product names for a given site based on optional filters. ALWAYS call the `api_getSites` tool first to resolve the relevant site UUID—even when falling back to the global site (call it with `name="Global"`). Provide the resolved UUID via `siteId` unless the user already supplied one.
function.name: api_returnsTheCountOfNetworkDeviceProductNamesForASite

productName.description: Filter with network device product name. Supports partial case-insensitive search. A minimum of 3 characters are required for search

siteId.description: UUID of the site whose product counts should be returned. Always translate site names or hierarchies into UUIDs by calling `api_getSites` first—even for the default global site (pass `name="Global"`). Defaults to the global site UUID when not provided. See https://developer.cisco.com/docs/dna-center/get-site/ for `siteId`.

count.description: Reports a count, for example, a total count of records in a given resource.
